title: Find Your Edge
subtitle: Discover, own, and unleash what makes you uniquely you.
kicker: A guide to showing up as yourself
narration: Find your edge. Discover, own, and unleash what makes you uniquely you. This is an invitation to look at yourself differently. Not to become someone else, but to recognize what you already bring to every room. Let's explore your strengths, hear what others see in you, and put your individuality into practice.

title: No One Is Exactly Like You
subtitle: Your quirks, passions, and perspective are not flaws. They’re your greatest asset in every room you walk into.
narration: No one is exactly like you. Your quirks, passions, and perspective are not flaws. They're your greatest asset in every room you walk into. Think about the things that make you different. The way you notice details, the subjects you care about, or the perspective you bring. Those differences are worth owning.

title: Why Unique Traits Matter
subtitle: In your social life, authenticity changes everything.
items: People remember those who stand out, not those who blend in.
Knowing your strengths ends the need for approval.
narration: Why do unique traits matter in social life? First, magnetic presence. People remember those who stand out, not those who blend in. Second, deeper connections. Authenticity attracts the right people. And third, unshakeable confidence. Knowing your strengths helps you stop looking for approval. Being yourself isn't about performing. It's about making genuine connection possible.

title: Look Inward
subtitle: Ask yourself the hard questions.
items: What do I do effortlessly that others struggle with?
What topics make me lose track of time?
What do friends always come to me for?
narration: Step one. Look inward. Ask yourself the hard questions. What do I do effortlessly that others struggle with? What topics make me lose track of time? What do friends always come to me for? Take a moment with each question. Your answers can reveal strengths you've overlooked because they feel so natural to you.

title: Seek Outside Mirrors
subtitle: Others often see what we can’t. Ask for honest feedback.
items: What’s the one word you’d use to describe me?
CliftonStrengths or the VIA Survey can help reveal hidden strengths.
What do people thank you for again and again?
narration: Step two. Seek outside mirrors. Others often see what we can't. Ask three close friends: what's the one word you'd use to describe me? Consider a strengths assessment, such as CliftonStrengths or the VIA Survey. And notice repeated compliments. What do people thank you for again and again? Reflect, clarify your personal trait statement, and validate it with feedback. Discovery is a loop. Revisit it as you grow.

title: Put It Into Practice
subtitle: Traits only become social superpowers when you use them — intentionally, consistently, and proudly.
narration: Step three. Put it into practice. Traits only become social superpowers when you use them intentionally, consistently, and proudly. Recognizing a strength is a beginning. Using it is what makes it real. Choose one trait you've discovered and bring it into your next interaction. You don't need to put on a performance. Just let more of your true self be visible.

title: Let Your Traits Show
subtitle: How to express your traits socially.
items: Bring up what you love. Enthusiasm is contagious.
Your quirks make you memorable and relatable.
Replace “I know this is weird, but…” with confident ownership.
A recurring phrase, gesture, or habit becomes part of your social brand.
narration: How can you express your traits socially? Lead with your passion. Bring up what you love early in conversation. Enthusiasm is contagious. Share stories, not stats. Anecdotes that reveal your quirks make you memorable and relatable. Stop apologizing for being different. Replace, I know this is weird, but, with confident ownership. And create your signature move. A recurring phrase, gesture, or habit can become part of your social brand.

title: Authenticity Compounds
subtitle: The loop doesn’t start with confidence. It builds it.
items: Express a trait you genuinely own.
Notice what happens when you’re authentic.
Bring that confidence into the next interaction.
narration: Harness the trait to connection loop. Authenticity compounds. Every time you show up as yourself and it works, your confidence grows, making the next interaction easier. Express a trait you genuinely own. Make a connection. Let the experience build your confidence. The loop doesn't start with confidence. It builds it.

title: Your Uniqueness Is the Invitation
subtitle: You don’t need to become someone else. Start with one true thing.
items: Share one true thing about yourself today.
narration: Your uniqueness is the invitation. Reflect. Journal your strengths weekly. Validate. Ask for feedback this week. Express. Share one true thing about yourself today. You don't need to become someone else to connect with others. Start with what is already yours. Discover it, own it, and let it show. Find your edge.
